data.name: Dinesh
data.gender_notes: Dinesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lord of the day; the sun
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit dina, 'day', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the day', i.e. the sun. Its root is Sanskrit dina + īśa. A classical Sanskrit name for the sun. Dinesh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the day; the sun”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dinesh expresses “Lord of the day; the sun”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit dina, 'day', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the day', i.e. the sun.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dinesh total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

vedic_reference.note: The name Dinesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dina' meaning day and 'ish' meaning lord. In Hindu mythology, Dinesh is considered as the god of the day, and is often depicted as the sun god Surya.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit name for the sun.
